podcast.title: U2's Indie Label (1985)
podcast.body: Sinead O'Connor's first manager, who helped her sign with Ensign Records, was the former head of Mother Records, U2's indie label, indicating his significant experience in the music industry. "And she got a manager who just happened to be the former head of Mother Records, U2's Indie label."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: U2 Ownership
podcast.body: Mother Records was owned by the band U2. "Much of the news came out of mother records, which was owned by you too."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
